products.name: Thin Veneer Stone Products
products.description: A comprehensive line of thin veneer stone products, including both manufactured and natural stone, distributed through a large network to residential and commercial construction markets. Products are sourced from various suppliers and delivered via a strategically located distribution network.

products.name: Manufactured Stone Veneer
products.description: Manufactured stone veneer products, including proprietary and third-party brands, produced using advanced manufacturing techniques and distributed through the company's network. Delivered to customers for use in construction and renovation projects.

products.name: Natural Stone Products
products.description: Natural stone products sourced from quarries worldwide, including ledgestone, ashlar, fieldstone, and panelized stone, distributed for use in construction and landscaping applications.

products.name: Mechanically Attached Stone Panels
products.description: Mechanically attached, panelized stone products designed for simplified installation, featuring moisture management systems and distributed to construction markets.

products.name: Landscape Stone Products
products.description: Natural stone landscape products such as pavers, steps, treads, pool coping, and slabs, curated from global sources and distributed for outdoor construction and landscaping projects.

products.name: Modular Masonry Fireplaces
products.description: High-performance, modular fireplace systems made from volcanic pumice, designed for energy efficiency and flexible installation in residential and commercial settings. Distributed under recognized brands.

products.name: Bromine
products.description: Manufactured by extracting bromine from natural brine using chemical and physical processes at licensed facilities in Shandong Province. The process involves pumping brine, chemical oxidation, and separation, with bromine stored in containers for industrial sale.

products.name: Crude Salt
products.description: Produced as a byproduct from the evaporation of wastewater after bromine extraction. The remaining brine is exposed to natural sunshine in pools, causing water to evaporate and leaving crude salt, which is then sold for industrial uses.

products.name: Chemical Products for Oil and Gas Field Exploration
products.description: Manufactured chemical agents used in oil and gas field exploration and distribution, produced at dedicated chemical facilities. Production involves chemical synthesis and formulation, with historical annual capacity over 26,000 tons.

products.name: Papermaking Chemical Agents
products.description: Manufactured chemical agents used in papermaking processes, produced at chemical plants through chemical synthesis and blending. Annual production capacity historically exceeded 5,000 tons.

products.name: Materials for Human and Animal Antibiotics
products.description: Manufactured chemical materials used as inputs for human and animal antibiotics, produced at specialized chemical facilities with an annual capacity over 6,800 tons.

products.name: Natural Gas
products.description: Produced from natural gas wells developed in Sichuan Province, involving drilling, extraction, and processing of natural gas for sale. Production is subject to regulatory approvals and uses specialized equipment for impurities removal.

products.name: Advanced Computing Solutions
products.description: High-performance and high-availability computing platforms and services, including hardware, software, and expert services for technical computing, AI, and HPC workloads, delivered via design, build, deployment, and management of infrastructure for core, edge, and cloud environments. Solutions are manufactured using a mix of in-house assembly and third-party contract manufacturing.

products.name: Fault Tolerant Computing Platforms and Software
products.description: Enterprise-grade, fault-tolerant computing platforms and software (Stratus brand) designed to ensure continuous availability of critical data and applications in data centers and edge locations, including zero-touch computing platforms, modular architectures, and virtualization protection, delivered as integrated hardware and software with managed services.

products.name: Specialty Integrated Memory and Storage Solutions
products.description: Design, development, and advanced packaging of specialty memory and storage products, including DRAM modules, solid-state/flash storage, and ruggedized/custom memory solutions for demanding applications. Products are manufactured using advanced PCB and device packaging technologies and tailored to OEM requirements.

products.name: Embedded and Removable Flash Memory Products
products.description: Manufacture of embedded and removable flash memory products, such as SSDs, SATA and PCIe NVMe drives, eMMC, USB, SD, and microSD cards, with custom firmware and ruggedized options, for use in industrial, enterprise, and communications applications.

products.name: Supply Chain Services
products.description: Customized, integrated supply chain services including procurement, logistics, inventory management, warehousing, programming, kitting, and packaging, delivered via proprietary software platforms integrated with customer and supplier systems, supporting manufacturing and distribution operations globally.

products.name: Optimized LED Chips and Components
products.description: Design, packaging, and sale of application-optimized LED chips and packaged LED components (Cree LED brand), including blue, green, and white LEDs, SMD and through-hole components, for use in lighting, video displays, automotive, medical, and specialty applications. Manufacturing involves packaging dies, testing, and assembly on substrates or PCBs.

products.name: Bria-IMT Immunotherapy
products.description: A whole-cell, genetically engineered human breast cancer cell line immunotherapy designed to activate the immune system to attack and destroy breast cancer tumors. Delivered via inoculation, manufactured under cGMP by third-party contract manufacturers, and administered in clinical settings, often in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

products.name: Bria-OTS Personalized Off-the-Shelf Immunotherapy
products.description: A personalized, off-the-shelf immunotherapy platform using engineered cell lines expressing multiple HLA types to match patients, enabling rapid, HLA-matched treatment for metastatic breast cancer and other cancers. Manufactured by contract organizations and delivered as a cellular therapy, either as monotherapy or in combination with checkpoint inhibitors.

products.name: Bria-PROS+ Immunotherapy
products.description: An enhanced, next-generation off-the-shelf immunotherapy cell line platform (Bria-PROS+) developed for prostate cancer, expressing co-stimulatory molecules and cytokines. Manufactured by contract organizations and intended for clinical use as a cellular therapy.

products.name: Bria-BRES+ Immunotherapy
products.description: A next-generation, enhanced off-the-shelf immunotherapy cell line (Bria-BRES+) for breast cancer, expressing additional co-stimulatory molecules and cytokines. Developed for use as a cellular therapy in clinical settings.

products.name: Bria-LUNG+ and Bria-MEL+ Immunotherapies
products.description: Pipeline off-the-shelf immunotherapy cell lines in development for lung cancer (Bria-LUNG+) and melanoma (Bria-MEL+), based on the Bria-OTS+ platform, expressing co-stimulatory molecules and cytokines for use as cellular therapies.

products.name: Bria-TILsRx Platform (Multi-Specific Binding Reagents)
products.description: A preclinical immunotherapy platform developing multi-specific binding agents and antibodies (e.g., against B7-H3) to activate tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and overcome immune suppression in various cancers. Delivered as antibody-based therapeutics, leveraging molecular modeling and AI-driven discovery.

products.name: Protein Kinase C Delta (PKCδ) Inhibitors
products.description: A preclinical small molecule program developing PKCδ inhibitors for cancer, discovered using AI-driven drug discovery and intended for use as targeted cancer therapeutics.

products.name: Soluble CD80 (sCD80) Biologic Agent
products.description: A biologic agent licensed from UMBC, consisting of soluble CD80 protein for the treatment of cancer. Intended for development and commercialization as a therapeutic biologic.

products.name: Connectivity Solutions (Terminals and Connector Systems)
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of terminals and connector systems that enable the distribution of power, signal, and data across a wide range of industries. These are physical components produced in manufacturing facilities and delivered to customers globally.

products.name: Sensor Solutions
products.description: Development and supply of intelligent, efficient, and high-performing sensor products used in automotive, industrial, medical, aerospace, and consumer applications. These are manufactured electronic components integrated into customer systems.

products.name: Heat Shrink Tubing and Protection Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of heat shrink tubing and related insulation and protection products for electrical, electronic, and industrial applications. These are physical products produced in manufacturing facilities and distributed globally.

products.name: Relays and Application Tooling
products.description: Production and sale of relays and application tooling used for electrical switching and assembly in automotive, industrial, and energy markets. These are manufactured components and tools delivered to OEMs and other customers.

products.name: Wire, Cable, and Filters
products.description: Manufacture and sale of wire, cable, and filter products for power, data, and signal transmission in industrial, energy, and transportation markets. These are physical products produced in manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Interventional Medical Components and Devices
products.description: Design and manufacture of advanced interventional medical components and devices for imaging, diagnostic, surgical, and minimally invasive applications. These are regulated, precision-manufactured products supplied to medical device companies.

products.name: Digital Data Network Solutions
products.description: Provision of connectivity products and solutions for networking, data centers, wireless infrastructure, and IoT devices, including support for artificial intelligence and machine learning applications. These are manufactured components and systems integrated into digital infrastructure.

products.name: Automation and Connected Living Solutions
products.description: Development and supply of connectivity and control products for factory and warehouse automation, building automation, smart city infrastructure, and home appliances. These are manufactured components and systems used in industrial and consumer environments.

products.name: Aerospace, Defense, and Marine Electronic Components and Systems
products.description: Design, development, and manufacture of electronic components and systems for aerospace, defense, and marine industries, engineered to operate in harsh environments. These are regulated, high-reliability products supplied to OEMs and system integrators.

products.name: Energy Grid and Renewables Connection Solutions
products.description: Manufacture and sale of insulation, protection, and connection products for electrical power generation, transmission, distribution, and renewables. These are physical products supplied to utilities, OEMs, and EPC companies.

products.name: Natural Aggregates
products.description: Produced primarily from open pit quarries and one underground mine, these include sand, gravel, crushed stone, and stabilized material, distributed regionally for use in concrete, asphalt, cement, and infrastructure projects. Delivery is physical and localized due to high transportation costs.

products.name: Recycled Aggregates
products.description: Manufactured by crushing reclaimed concrete and asphalt from demolished structures, processed to remove debris and screened for use as road base, erosion control, and building foundations. Production is physical and relies on demolition material supply.

products.name: Specialty Materials
products.description: Includes lightweight aggregates, select natural aggregates, and processed specialty building and agricultural products, produced at quarries and specialized facilities using minerals like shale, clay, limestone, and gypsum. Products are distributed nationwide for use in construction, agriculture, and industrial applications.

products.name: Asphalt Mix and Paving Services
products.description: Production and sale of asphalt mix, primarily in New Jersey, using aggregates and recycled materials, with additional provision of asphalt construction paving services. Operations are co-located with aggregates quarries for efficient supply chain.

products.name: Construction Site Support Equipment (Trench Shields and Shoring Products)
products.description: Manufactures trench shields and shoring products for underground construction, water and sewer projects, and utility installations, with some participation in regional rental markets. Products are physically manufactured and distributed to contractors and rental dealers.

products.name: Utility Structures
products.description: Manufactures engineered steel and pre-stressed concrete utility structures, including poles and substation structures, for electricity transmission and distribution. Production is at dedicated plants in the U.S. and Mexico, serving utilities and infrastructure projects.

products.name: Wind Towers
products.description: Manufactures large structural wind towers at specialized plants in North America, supplying wind turbine producers for renewable energy projects. Production is capital-intensive and steel-based.

products.name: Traffic and Lighting Structures
products.description: Produces steel and concrete poles and structures for transportation and lighting applications, manufactured at multiple U.S. plants and sold to contractors and government agencies for infrastructure projects.

products.name: Telecommunication Structures
products.description: Manufactures telecom structures such as lattice towers, monopole towers, and guyed towers at a dedicated plant, serving wireless carriers and tower developers. Production is steel-based and specialized.

products.name: Inland Barges and Marine Hardware
products.description: Manufactures inland barges (hopper, tank, deck, and specialized types), fiberglass barge covers, and marine hardware such as winches and hatches, at facilities along U.S. inland river systems. Products are delivered to commercial marine transportation companies and shippers.

products.name: Gold Doré
products.description: Unrefined gold bullion bars containing over 90% gold, produced at multiple mine sites and sold primarily to banks and central banks. Production requires large-scale mining operations, ore processing, and third-party refining.

products.name: Silver Concentrates
products.description: Silver-rich mineral concentrates produced primarily at the Puna mine, requiring mining, ore processing, and concentration, and sold to smelters or traders for further refining.

products.name: Lead Concentrates
products.description: Lead concentrates with high silver content produced at the Puna mine, involving mining and concentration processes, and sold to smelters or traders under supply contracts for further refining.

products.name: Zinc Concentrates
products.description: Zinc concentrates, often with high silver content, produced at the Puna mine through mining and concentration, and sold to smelters or traders for further refining.

products.name: Copper Concentrates
products.description: Copper is produced as a minor by-product from mining operations, included in concentrates and sold externally, though it represents a de minimis portion of revenue.

products.name: Regional Airline Capacity Services
products.description: Provision of scheduled passenger flight operations using a fleet of Embraer E170/175 regional jets under Capacity Purchase Agreements (CPAs) with major airlines (American Airlines, Delta Air Lines, United Airlines). Republic supplies aircraft, crew, maintenance, and operational expertise, while the partner airlines control marketing, ticketing, and route selection. Services are delivered through physical operation of flights and require regulatory compliance, in-person labor, and significant capital investment in aircraft and infrastructure.

products.name: Flight Training Services (LIFT Academy and Bridge Air)
products.description: Provision of professional pilot and aviation maintenance technician training through proprietary flight schools (LIFT Academy and Bridge Air), including flight instruction, simulator training, and apprenticeship programs. These services are delivered via physical campuses, aircraft, and simulators, and are designed to prepare students for aviation careers, with some programs offering defined career pathways to Republic or partner airlines.

products.name: Haircutting and Styling Services
products.description: Professional haircutting and styling services, including shampooing and conditioning, delivered in-person by trained stylists at franchised and company-owned salons.

products.name: Hair Coloring Services
products.description: In-person hair coloring services provided by professional stylists at salon locations, requiring technical skill and regulated products.

products.name: Retail Hair Care and Beauty Products
products.description: Sale of nationally recognized hair care and beauty products, including brands like L'Oreal Professional and John Paul Mitchell, through salon locations; products are demonstrated and recommended by stylists.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to businesses for expansion, asset purchases, and agricultural production, typically secured by business assets or collateral. Delivered through in-person banking branches and loan production offices, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by commercial real estate, including construction loans for new projects. Underwriting is based on cash flows and collateral value, with disbursements controlled during construction. Delivered via physical branches and loan offices, requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates and underwrites mortgages for 1-4 family residences, including both portfolio adjustable-rate loans and long-term fixed mortgages (the latter sold to secondary market purchasers). Delivered through branch network and loan offices, requiring regulatory compliance and financial capital.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides loans to individuals, including home equity loans and lines, secured loans (e.g., auto, boat, RV), cash/CD secured, and unsecured loans. Delivered through branches and digital channels, requiring financial capital and compliance with consumer lending regulations.

products.name: Lease Financing
products.description: Offers lease financing services to customers, enabling acquisition of assets through leasing arrangements. Delivered via branch network and loan production offices, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Trust Account Services
products.description: Provides trust account management and related fiduciary services to customers, involving in-person expertise and regulated infrastructure. Delivered through specialized staff at branch locations.

products.name: Depositor Services
products.description: Offers deposit accounts and related services, including checking, savings, and certificates of deposit, with FDIC insurance. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Industrial Gas Production and Development
products.description: Exploration, drilling, and development of industrial gas wells, including the design and construction of processing facilities and gathering systems. This involves physical extraction, infrastructure development, and regulatory compliance for production and potential injection/disposal of gases such as carbon dioxide.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Operation and development of oil and natural gas producing properties, including drilling, completion, and production from wells across various U.S. regions. This requires significant physical infrastructure, in-person labor, and compliance with extensive regulations.

products.name: Handheld Point-of-Care Ultrasound Devices (Butterfly iQ+, iQ3)
products.description: Portable, semiconductor-based ultrasound devices for whole-body imaging, designed for use by healthcare practitioners at the point-of-care. Devices connect to smartphones or tablets and are powered by proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology, enabling affordable, mobile imaging.

products.name: Ultrasound Software Subscriptions and Cloud Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software and analytics subscriptions that integrate with Butterfly devices, offering image storage, workflow integration, AI-driven tools, and connectivity to electronic medical records. Delivered digitally via annual or enterprise subscriptions for individuals and institutions.

products.name: Enterprise Ultrasound Platform (Compass AI™)
products.description: Device-agnostic enterprise software platform for hospitals and health systems, enabling scaled integration, workflow automation, quality assurance, and centralized management of ultrasound programs. Delivered as a cloud-based solution integrated with hospital IT systems.

products.name: Cart-Based Ultrasound Solutions (Butterfly Move, iQ+ Bladder)
products.description: All-in-one cart-based ultrasound systems combining Butterfly’s handheld probe technology with docking stations, carts, tablets, and specialty probes (e.g., bladder scanning), targeting clinical environments requiring both mobility and stability.

products.name: Veterinary Handheld Ultrasound Devices (Butterfly iQ+/iQ3 Vet)
products.description: Handheld, semiconductor-based ultrasound devices specifically designed for veterinary applications, featuring animal-specific probes and imaging tools for use by veterinarians in various care settings.

products.name: Ultrasound Education and Training Services
products.description: Educational software, in-app tutorials, formal courses, and hands-on training programs (e.g., Butterfly Academy™, Butterfly Certified™, ScanLab™) for clinicians and medical students to build ultrasound proficiency. Delivered digitally and in-person.

products.name: Professional Services for Ultrasound Deployment
products.description: Consulting and implementation services for large-scale ultrasound deployments, including workflow integration, credentialing, and program management for healthcare enterprises.

products.name: Licensing and Co-Development of Ultrasound-on-Chip™ Technology (Butterfly Embedded™)
products.description: Licensing of proprietary semiconductor ultrasound platform to third parties for co-development of novel medical and non-medical technologies, including wearables, implantables, and robotics. Delivered via technology licensing agreements and collaborative development.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, and production of unconventional natural gas from the Beetaloo Basin, delivered via pipelines to domestic and export markets. This involves physical extraction, processing at company-operated facilities, and transportation through third-party and company-partnered pipelines.

products.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Export
products.description: Production and export of LNG through proposed and existing LNG facilities, including the development of the Northern Territory LNG (NTLNG) project and supply to existing LNG export terminals. This requires large-scale physical infrastructure, engineering, and regulatory compliance for international shipping.

products.name: Global 3P Accelerator
products.description: A comprehensive ecommerce acceleration service where Pattern purchases inventory from brand partners and sells products directly to consumers on global ecommerce marketplaces, leveraging proprietary technology, data, and operational expertise. This involves physical inventory management, fulfillment, and digital optimization.

products.name: 1P Accelerator
products.description: A service enabling brands to use Pattern's technology, services, and operational expertise to manage their own first-party selling on ecommerce marketplaces, with Pattern providing platform and service support without purchasing inventory. Delivered via digital platform and expert services.

products.name: Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software tools, including PXM and Creators, for managing and optimizing product content across ecommerce channels and for recruiting, engaging, and managing affiliate and creator marketing campaigns. Delivered digitally as subscription or usage-based services.

products.name: Fulfillment and Marketplace Preparation Services
products.description: Logistics and shipping services, including marketplace preparation and delivery to ecommerce marketplaces and direct-to-consumer channels, supporting third-party sellers with efficient inbound logistics and fulfillment. Involves physical warehousing, inventory management, and integration with marketplace systems.

products.name: Consulting and Design Services
products.description: Professional services supporting brand partners with market analysis, category insights, packaging, product design, and prototyping, delivered by Pattern's experts to enhance brand strategy and creative execution. Involves human expertise and digital tools.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering, Processing, and Marketing Services
products.description: Provides gathering, treating, processing, and marketing of natural gas and extraction of NGLs through a network of processing facilities and pipelines. Services are delivered via physical infrastructure and contracts, including fee-based and commodity-based arrangements.

products.name: NGL (Natural Gas Liquids) Transportation, Fractionation, Storage, and Marine Terminal Services
products.description: Transports, fractionates, stores, and exports/imports NGLs (including ethane, propane, butane, isobutane, and natural gasoline) via pipelines, fractionators, underground storage, and marine terminals. Services are provided through regulated and unregulated infrastructure, including export terminals and storage caverns.

products.name: Crude Oil Gathering, Transportation, Storage, and Marine Terminal Services
products.description: Offers crude oil gathering, transportation, storage, and export/import terminal services through a network of pipelines, storage tanks, and marine terminals. Services are provided under regulated tariffs or contracts and include access to major refining and export markets.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipelines and Storage Services
products.description: Provides natural gas gathering, treating, transportation, and storage services via extensive pipeline systems and underground storage facilities. Services are delivered under regulated and contractual arrangements to utilities, industrial customers, and marketers.

products.name: Petrochemical Production and Marketing (Propylene, Isobutylene, Octane Enhancement, HPIB)
products.description: Produces and markets petrochemicals including propylene (via fractionation and PDH), isobutylene (via iBDH), octane enhancement products (isooctane, MTBE), and high purity isobutylene. Production is through specialized chemical facilities integrated with pipeline and storage infrastructure.

products.name: Petrochemical and Refined Products Transportation, Storage, and Marine Terminal Services
products.description: Transports, stores, and handles petrochemicals and refined products (such as motor gasoline, distillates, and NGLs) via pipelines, storage terminals, and marine export/import terminals. Services are provided to producers, refiners, and marketers through regulated and unregulated infrastructure.

products.name: Refined Products Marketing
products.description: Markets and sells refined petroleum products (e.g., gasoline, distillates) obtained from producers and the open market, leveraging pipeline, terminal, and storage assets. Revenue is generated from price differentials and logistics services.

products.name: Ethylene Export Terminal and Related Services
products.description: Operates an ethylene export terminal and associated pipelines and storage, enabling the export and trading of ethylene for global petrochemical customers. Services are delivered via dedicated marine terminal and pipeline infrastructure.

products.name: Marine Transportation Services for Energy Products
products.description: Provides marine transportation of refined products, crude oil, LPG, and other petroleum products using a fleet of tow boats and tank barges on U.S. inland and intracoastal waterways. Services are regulated and delivered via owned and operated vessels.

products.name: Satellite Platforms and Customization
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells modular, hybrid 3D-printed satellite platforms (LizzieSat, GeoLizzie, LunarLizzie) for deployment in LEO, GEO, and lunar orbits, supporting a range of customer payloads and mission objectives. Production is performed in a vertically integrated facility with advanced manufacturing capabilities.

products.name: Payload Hosting and Mission Services
products.description: Provides hosting of customer payloads on Sidus satellites, including mission planning, payload integration, satellite monitoring, control, and data delivery, supported by a 24/7 Mission Control Center and regulatory authorizations.

products.name: Space and Defense Hardware Manufacturing
products.description: Manufactures precision-machined hardware, avionics assemblies, cable harnesses, and mechanical components for space and defense applications, using certified manufacturing processes (ISO 9001, AS9100) and supporting both proprietary and customer designs.

products.name: AI-Enabled Edge Computing Systems
products.description: Develops and sells radiation-tolerant edge processors (FeatherEdge), modular computing products (Fortis VPX), and AI software (Cielo) for on-orbit and multi-domain data processing, analytics, and mission-critical applications across space, air, land, and sea.

products.name: Engineering and Systems Integration Services
products.description: Offers multi-disciplinary engineering, systems integration, and technical services for satellite, avionics, and hardware projects, including design, assembly, testing, and regulatory support for commercial, government, and defense customers.

products.name: Space-Based Data and Analytics Solutions
products.description: Provides subscription-based access to space-derived data and analytics, leveraging Sidus satellites and AI-enabled systems to deliver actionable intelligence for maritime, environmental, and defense applications.

products.name: Dredging Services
products.description: Comprehensive dredging services including capital, coastal protection, and maintenance dredging, performed with a fleet of specialized vessels and equipment in U.S. coastal waterways, ports, and inland waterways. Services involve physical removal or replenishment of soil, sand, or rock to enhance navigability, protect shorelines, restore habitats, and create aquatic infrastructure.

products.name: Offshore Energy Services
products.description: Installation and protection of subsea infrastructure for offshore wind, oil and gas, and power and telecommunication industries, utilizing specialized vessels such as the subsea rock installation (SRI) vessel for rock placement and cable/pipeline protection, delivered both domestically and internationally.

products.name: Business Communications Services (UCaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based unified communications services for businesses of all sizes, offering voice, messaging, video conferencing, call center features, and integrations, delivered via SaaS platforms and on-premise devices.

products.name: POTS Line Replacement Solutions (Ooma AirDial)
products.description: Turnkey replacement for legacy analog phone lines (POTS), combining a base station, virtual analog phone service, and wireless data connectivity, supporting safety and business-critical systems.

products.name: Residential Phone Services
products.description: Cloud-based home phone services providing HD voice, advanced calling features, and mobile integration, delivered via Ooma Telo devices and mobile apps, with subscription and device sales.

products.name: Mobile Communications App (Talkatone)
products.description: Free and premium mobile app for iOS and Android enabling users to make and receive calls and texts over Wi-Fi or cellular data, monetized via advertising and premium features.

products.name: Connected Home Security and Monitoring Products
products.description: Sensors and accessories for home security and monitoring, integrated with Ooma's residential platform, sold as add-ons to phone services.

products.name: Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS) and Call Center as a Service (CCaaS) for Resellers and Carriers (2600Hz)
products.description: Cloud-based communications and call center platforms offered to resellers and carriers, providing APIs, UCaaS, CPaaS, CCaaS, and carrier services for integration and customization.

products.name: Hotel Ownership and Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of premium-branded, rooms-oriented, focused-service and compact full-service hotels, primarily under franchise agreements with leading brands such as Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and Wyndham. The company acquires, owns, and leases these hotel properties, which are operated by independent managers and generate revenue through guest room rentals and related services. This business requires significant real estate investment, asset management, and compliance with hospitality regulations.

products.name: Apparel and Accessories Rental Services
products.description: Customers can rent designer apparel and accessories, including evening wear, workwear, casual wear, maternity, outerwear, activewear, jewelry, handbags, and more, through monthly subscription plans or a-la-carte rentals. The service is delivered via a digital platform with physical fulfillment, leveraging proprietary logistics and cleaning infrastructure.

products.name: Pre-Owned Apparel and Accessories Resale
products.description: Customers can purchase pre-worn designer apparel and accessories from the company's inventory at significant discounts to retail prices. This is facilitated through the same digital platform and fulfillment infrastructure as the rental business.

products.name: Exclusive Designs Apparel
products.description: The company collaborates with select brand partners to create exclusive apparel collections, manufactured through third-party partners for enhanced durability and cost efficiency, and offered exclusively for rent (and later for resale) on the platform.

products.name: B2B Cleaning Services (Pilot)
products.description: The company has launched pilot business-to-business cleaning services, utilizing its warehouse operations and garment care infrastructure to provide cleaning for external clients.

products.name: Brand Advertising and Partnership Services
products.description: Brands can access advertising and partnership opportunities, such as sampling programs and sponsored content, to market to the company's customer base via the platform and other channels.

products.name: Tegoprubart for Prevention of Kidney Transplant Rejection
products.description: A biologic (IgG1, anti-CD40L antibody) developed and delivered via infusion to prevent rejection in kidney transplantation, aiming to replace calcineurin inhibitor-based immunosuppression with a safer, more effective therapy. Manufactured using third-party facilities and distributed for clinical use.

products.name: Tegoprubart for Prevention of Xenotransplant Rejection
products.description: Tegoprubart is supplied for use as an immunosuppressive biologic in xenotransplantation (animal-to-human organ and cell transplants), delivered as part of clinical and preclinical protocols to prevent rejection of genetically modified pig organs and islet cells.

products.name: Tegoprubart for Islet Cell Transplantation in Type 1 Diabetes
products.description: Tegoprubart is provided as an immunosuppressive biologic to prevent rejection and improve graft survival in pancreatic islet cell transplantation for type 1 diabetes, supplied for investigator-initiated clinical trials and not directly funded by the company.

products.name: Tegoprubart for Treatment of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
products.description: Tegoprubart is developed as a biologic therapy for ALS, aiming to inhibit neuroinflammatory pathways by blocking CD40L, delivered via infusion in clinical trials to slow disease progression. Manufacturing and distribution are outsourced to third parties.

products.name: Pipeline Construction and Maintenance Services
products.description: Construction, replacement, and repair of natural gas, petroleum, water, and sewer pipelines, including both interstate and intrastate pipelines, as well as related storage and pump station facilities. Delivered through union and non-union labor, often requiring heavy equipment and compliance with industry regulations.

products.name: Electrical and Mechanical Installation and Repair Services
products.description: Full range of electrical, mechanical, HVAC/R, controls, and fire protection installations and repairs for industrial customers, including substation and switchyard services, equipment setting, pipe fabrication, and transformer installation. Services are delivered by skilled union labor and require specialized technical expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: General Contracting and Building Construction Services
products.description: General contracting for new construction and renovation of buildings, schools, and small bridges, primarily for state and local government agencies and commercial customers. Projects are managed and often subcontracted, requiring project management and compliance with public sector standards.

products.name: Corrosion Protection and Cathodic Protection Services
products.description: Provision of corrosion protection and cathodic protection services for pipelines and related infrastructure, involving specialized engineering and regulatory compliance to ensure pipeline integrity and longevity.

products.name: Horizontal and Directional Drilling Services
products.description: Horizontal and directional drilling services for pipeline, broadband, and utility installations, utilizing specialized drilling equipment and skilled operators to minimize surface disruption.

products.name: Utility Paving and Sealcoating Services
products.description: Paving and sealcoating services for utility and water distribution customers, involving road and surface restoration after pipeline or utility work, delivered with paving equipment and skilled labor.

products.name: Broadband and Solar System Installation Services
products.description: Installation of broadband infrastructure and solar electric systems for commercial and residential customers, requiring technical expertise in telecommunications and renewable energy systems.

products.name: Intelligent Electric Vehicles (FF Series)
products.description: Design, engineering, manufacturing, and sale of ultra-luxury, AI-enhanced electric vehicles under the FF brand, such as the FF 91 and FF 92, produced at the company's own manufacturing facility and incorporating proprietary software, connectivity, and user-centric technologies.

products.name: Intelligent Electric Vehicles (FX Series)
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and sale of premium and mass-market AI-enhanced electric vehicles under the FX brand, including models like FX Super One, FX 4, and FX 6, offered with both battery-electric and AI hybrid extended-range powertrains, assembled in the U.S. and planned for international markets.

products.name: AI Hybrid Extended-Range Powertrain Systems (AIHER)
products.description: Design and development of AI-driven hybrid extended-range and range-extender powertrain systems, intended for integration into electric vehicles to enhance range and energy management, with commercialization planned for future FX models.

products.name: Vehicle Software and AI-Enabled Digital Ecosystem
products.description: Development and provision of proprietary vehicle operating systems, infotainment, connectivity, and AI-driven user experience platforms (such as FF aiOS, I.A.I. system, and Super EAI F.A.C.E. System), delivered as integrated features in vehicles and supporting over-the-air updates and personalized services.

products.name: After-Sales Services and Vehicle Support
products.description: Provision of vehicle repair, maintenance, bodywork, and remote/mobile service solutions through partner-owned experience centers, third-party service centers, and digital platforms, supporting customers post-sale in the U.S. and internationally.

products.name: Home and Public Charging Solutions
products.description: Offering home charging installation programs and public charging credits for electric vehicle customers, including Wi-Fi-connected smart chargers and partnerships with charging networks, delivered through collaborations with third-party providers.

products.name: Digital Asset and Blockchain Infrastructure (via AIXC)
products.description: Development of digital platforms and blockchain infrastructure supporting the company’s artificial intelligence and digital ecosystem strategy, primarily through the majority-owned subsidiary AIxCrypto Holdings, with current activities focused on technology evaluation and platform development.

products.name: Mutation-Selective PI3Kα Inhibitors (OKI-219 and pipeline)
products.description: Orally administered small molecule drugs designed to selectively inhibit mutated forms of PI3Kα (such as H1047R, E542K, E545K) while sparing wild-type PI3Kα, produced using structure-based drug design, medicinal chemistry, and manufactured by third-party CMOs. Delivered as oral therapeutics for cancers (initially breast cancer) and other diseases driven by PI3Kα mutations.

products.name: Pan-Mutant PI3Kα Inhibitors
products.description: Small molecule drugs in development that selectively inhibit all the most common PI3Kα mutations (H1047R, E542K, E545K), intended for broader cancer populations beyond breast cancer. These are developed using precision drug design and are expected to be orally administered and manufactured by third-party CMOs.

products.name: PI3Kα Inhibitors for Vascular Malformations
products.description: Precision small molecule kinase inhibitors targeting PI3Kα mutations implicated in vascular malformations, developed using the company’s drug discovery platform and intended for patient populations with these rare diseases. These are in early discovery and preclinical stages.

products.name: Climbing, Skiing, and Technical Mountain Sports Equipment
products.description: High-performance equipment and apparel for climbing, mountaineering, trail running, backpacking, skiing, and other outdoor recreation activities, including apparel, footwear, headlamps, trekking poles, gloves, backpacks, avalanche airbags, avalanche safety devices, carabiners, harnesses, protection devices, and related accessories. Products are designed, developed, and tested in-house and manufactured in third-party facilities.

products.name: Automotive Roof Racks and Accessories
products.description: Highly-engineered automotive roof racks, trays, mounting systems, luggage boxes, carriers, shade awnings, kayak carriers, bike carriers, and load-securing accessories designed and manufactured for outdoor enthusiasts and tradesmen. Products are engineered and distributed globally, with manufacturing in ISO-certified facilities.

products.name: Vehicle Recovery and Extraction Gear
products.description: Recovery boards and tracks, as well as other outdoor and recovery gear for overlanding, off-road, 4x4 automotive touring, camping, and caravanning markets. Products are manufactured using proprietary, engineering-grade materials and are distributed globally to retailers, distributors, and direct consumers.

products.name: Bicycle Transport Systems and Accessories
products.description: Premium bicycle racks and transport systems, including roof and hitch rack solutions and related accessories compatible with vehicles of all sizes. Products are designed for durability and style, and are distributed primarily in North America through retailers and direct channels.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate (CRE), commercial and industrial (C&I), and Small Business Administration (SBA) loans. These loans are originated through in-person relationship banking, branch networks, and specialized lending teams, and are typically secured by business assets or real estate.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers residential mortgage loans, including adjustable-rate loans for owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied properties, originated through retail branches, correspondent relationships, and selective purchases from third-party originators.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides unsecured consumer loans and lines of credit, primarily to high-net-worth individuals, delivered through branch networks and relationship banking.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offers a wide range of deposit accounts for business and consumer customers, including demand, savings, money market, and time deposit accounts, delivered through physical branches and digital banking channels.

products.name: Mortgage Warehouse Lending
products.description: Provides warehouse lines of credit to non-bank mortgage originators to finance short-term residential mortgage production, delivered through specialized lending teams.

products.name: Third-Party Food Production Verification and Certification Services
products.description: On-site and desk audits to verify claims about livestock, aquaculture, crops, and other food products, ensuring compliance with standards such as non-GMO, organic, humane handling, and sustainability. Delivered by trained auditors and verification specialists, often required for regulatory or export purposes.

products.name: Professional Consulting and Technology Solutions for Food and Agriculture
products.description: Consulting, data analysis, reporting, and technology solutions tailored to the food and agricultural industry, supporting verification, risk mitigation, and sustainable value creation. Delivered by industry experts and technology professionals.

products.name: Cattle Identification Ear Tags and Traceability Products
products.description: Physical products such as electronic identification (EID) ear tags for cattle, enabling animal identification and traceability from birth to slaughter, supporting compliance with regulatory requirements. Manufactured and sold as ancillary to verification services.

products.name: Source Verified® Retail and Restaurant Labeling Program
products.description: A labeling and information-sharing program that connects consumers to the source of their food through verified product attributes, using product labeling and web-based education. Delivered via physical labels and digital platforms.

products.name: General Insurance Products
products.description: A broad suite of insurance products including commercial property and casualty, financial lines (such as D&O and E&O), specialty risks (aerospace, energy, marine, crop), personal lines (auto, homeowners, high net worth), accident & health, and travel insurance. These products are underwritten and delivered through a global network, requiring regulated infrastructure, in-person human labor, and significant capital reserves.

products.name: Life and Retirement Products
products.description: A comprehensive portfolio of life insurance (term, universal, group, international), annuities (fixed, variable, index), group retirement plans, institutional products (stable value wraps, pension risk transfer, structured settlements, GICs), and mutual funds. These products are manufactured and delivered through regulated insurance entities, requiring actuarial expertise, capital reserves, and a mix of digital and in-person distribution.

products.name: Mutual Funds and Investment Products
products.description: Retail mutual funds and related investment products and services, including administration and advisory services, distributed primarily through broker-dealers and financial advisors. These are digital and service-based offerings, requiring investment management infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Reinsurance Services
products.description: Reinsurance products and services, including both assumed and ceded reinsurance, provided through subsidiaries such as Validus Re and Fortitude Re. These services involve underwriting and managing insurance risk for other insurers, requiring significant capital, actuarial expertise, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Warranty and Extended Service Contracts
products.description: Extended warranty insurance and services covering electronics, appliances, and HVAC, delivered through partnerships with retailers and service providers. These are regulated insurance products requiring claims administration and customer service infrastructure.

products.name: Home Buying and Selling Platform
products.description: A digital platform that enables homeowners to sell their home directly to Opendoor for cash and allows buyers to purchase homes owned and listed by Opendoor. The process is largely online, supported by AI-powered pricing, data-driven home assessments, and centralized operations, with Opendoor acting as principal in the transaction (not as a broker).

products.name: Cash Plus Offer
products.description: A variant of the core home sale product where homeowners sell to Opendoor, receive most proceeds upfront, and may participate in resale upside if the home sells for more, with Opendoor handling repairs, listing, and resale. Delivered digitally and operationally integrated with the main platform.

products.name: Title Insurance and Escrow Services
products.description: Integrated title insurance and escrow services provided through Opendoor subsidiaries, offered to buyers and sellers as part of the transaction process. These services are regulated, require licensing, and are delivered both digitally and through operational teams.

products.name: Mortgage Products
products.description: Mortgage origination services offered through a licensed subsidiary, enabling buyers to obtain financing for home purchases. This service is regulated and involves both digital application processes and compliance with lending laws.

products.name: Artificial Insemination Solution (FemaSeed)
products.description: A medical device-based, in-office artificial insemination solution that delivers sperm directly into the fallopian tube (intratubal insemination) to enhance fertilization. Manufactured in-house, FDA-cleared and approved in multiple countries, it is delivered by healthcare professionals as a first-line, less invasive alternative to IUI and IVF.

products.name: Sperm Handling and Preparation Kits (FemSperm)
products.description: A suite of setup, preparation, and analysis kits enabling gynecologists to perform in-office sperm preparation and analysis for use with FemaSeed. These are physical kits manufactured and distributed for clinical use, expanding access to artificial insemination procedures.

products.name: Fallopian Tube Assessment and Diagnostic Devices (FemVue, FemCath, FemChec)
products.description: A portfolio of FDA-cleared and globally approved diagnostic devices for in-office ultrasound-based assessment of fallopian tube patency and selective tubal evaluation. These devices generate saline-air contrast for real-time imaging and are used as companion diagnostics for infertility and permanent birth control procedures.

products.name: Permanent Birth Control System (FemBloc)
products.description: A non-surgical, in-office permanent birth control system involving minimally invasive delivery of a proprietary synthetic tissue adhesive into both fallopian tubes to induce occlusion. The system includes a patented delivery device and blended polymer, manufactured in-house and distributed globally, offering an alternative to surgical sterilization.

products.name: Endocervical Tissue Sampler for Cervical Cancer Diagnosis (FemCerv)
products.description: A single-use, FDA-cleared and globally approved endocervical tissue sampling device for cervical cancer diagnosis, enabling gynecologists to obtain comprehensive cervical cell and tissue samples in-office. Manufactured and distributed as a physical medical device.
